nonClaims: This pack does not provide a real postcode lookup.
This pack does not infer a Bosnia and Herzegovina national postcode pattern from operator search surfaces.
This pack does not query, store, or redistribute operator routing results, postcode mappings, addresses, offices, contacts, or delivery information.
This pack does not download, store, or redistribute FBiH boundary or cadastral geometry, administrative values, or location records.
This pack does not assert a household, building, street, point, or address-to-postcode match.
This pack does not assert delivery-point or carrier deliverability coverage.
